title: Farmers, Indigenous Peoples continue camp out protest as QC probes altercation
summary: Farmers and indigenous peoples continued their “Kampuhang Magbubukid” protest in front of the Department of Agrarian Reform (DAR) central office in Quezon City on Tuesday, October 20.
